title: A · Unfinished Tower
pitch: A five-floor concrete frame on a building site that stopped: open floors on a column grid, holes through every slab, an open lift shaft, a collapsed bay and a tower crane still standing.
facts: Vertical: 17 m of building plus a 41 m crane.
Floors are open-sided, so most of the inside is lit and visible from outside.

features.name: Concrete frame
features.desc: 24 × 15 m, five floors every 3.35 m, roof at 16.9 m, 0.4 m columns on a 6 × 5 m grid.

features.name: Open lift shaft
features.desc: 2.2 m square, open from the roof to the ground floor: a 17 m dive.

features.name: Stairs
features.desc: One flight per floor in the east bay, through matching floor openings (1.8 × 4.8 m).

features.name: Broken floors
features.desc: Holes 2–5 m across in every floor, at different places on each.

features.name: Collapsed bay
features.desc: Floor 2's slab fell onto floor 1: a 37° ramp-shaped gap.

features.name: Brick infill
features.desc: Some sides of the lower floors are bricked in, with 1.5 × 1.4 m windows.

features.name: Roof
features.desc: Parapet with two gaps, a water tank on 1.2 m legs, rebar stubs.

features.name: Tower crane
features.desc: 34 m lattice mast (1.3 m openings), 35 m jib over the building, hook hanging at 20 m.

features.name: Yard
features.desc: Containers (one stacked), rubble piles, site office, dirt mound, site fence.

spots.note: Ground floor inside the frame, facing east between the columns.
In the yard, facing the building.
